text.p: Iran has commissioned a $33 million electron accelerator to be used for industrial purposes, state-run Tehran radio said on Sunday.
It said Iran's Atomic Energy Organisation opened the accelerator in the central city of Yazd. It was built for 100 billion rials ($33.3 million) with the help of Belgian and French technicians.

The accelerator will be used for various industrial purposes, the radio added. Iran has said its nuclear programme is strictly civilian and open to international inspection, denying U.S. charges it seeks to develop nuclear arms.
($1 = 3,000 rials at the official exchange rate)
